messages:
jessica: Heads-up — Holocene RFP landed. They want dedicated capacity for the Q4 holiday window. Baseline 3x H100s, ability to 2x burst for ~3 weeks. Spreadsheet in Drive: https://drive.redwood/holocene/rfp :eyes:
ryan_ops: grabbing numbers now. quick rough calc below, want to confirm workload shape (sync vs async).
ryan_ops: ```
baseline = 3 GPUs * 24 hrs * 30 days = 2160 GPU-hrs/month
burst windows = 21 days * 12 peak hrs/day * (6-3 extra GPUs) = 756 GPU-hrs
total_month_peak = 2160 + 756 = 2916 GPU-hrs
```
marco: math looks right if bursts are 12h/day. question: are bursts predictable daily or fully elastic? if predictable we can pre-warm and avoid cold spins.
priya: network note — Holocene is multi-region (us-west + eu-west). If they want cross-region failover we need spare capacity in eu-west; our current eu-west H100 pool has ~24 free slots this quarter. Also watch inter-region egress during reroutes.
eli_finance: pricing check: committed discount tiers: 40% off on-demand for reserve; burst will be billed at on-demand + 20% premium. If we propose ~2400 GPU-hrs commit we need a clear overage policy.
jessica: proposal draft: commit = 2400 GPU-hrs/month (covers baseline + modest headroom), 25% burst buffer (up to ~1000 GPU-hrs/month at premium), canary period 2 weeks before holiday to validate. Thoughts?
ryan_ops: +1 for commit=2400. That covers baseline (2160) + ~240 hrs buffer for unexpected. For heavy bursts we use burst pool; automatic fallback to quantized model reduces GPU time by ~30% in many workloads.
marco: to add — recommend model-variant fallback rule: if queue depth > 30s then route 50% requests to 8-bit quantized variant. Conservatively that saves ~200-300 GPU-hrs during peak.
priya: scheduling ops: we'll block maintenance windows during the 6-week period (2 weeks canary + 3 weeks holiday + 1 week cool-down). Also will add proactive infra alerts for NVLink/cable flaps — seen more flaky behavior under sustained bursts.
eli_finance: contract terms: commit 2400 -> 40% off list. Overage bill = on-demand * 1.2. Suggest a soft cap with notifications at 80% of commit to avoid surprises.
jessica: agree. let's also add SLA language for pre-warm failure: if we fail to deliver pre-warm capacity, credits limited to pro-rated commit discounts (standard clause).
deploy-bot: capacity-check output:
```
region us-west2: H100 available slots=18, reserved for Holocene=6
region eu-west1: H100 available slots=22, reserved for Holocene=0
expected pool after pre-warm (us-west2)=6 reserved + 4 pre-warm = 10 occupied, remaining=8
```
ryan_ops: next steps: (1) confirm burst daily profile w/ Holocene (peak hours), (2) finalize commit 2400 + burst pool terms, (3) schedule 2-week canary and pre-warm runbook, (4) instrument quantized fallback and run load test.
marco: I'll open infra ticket for capacity reservation + NVLink health checks.
priya: I'll draft runbook and SLO adjustments for the window.
eli_finance: I'll slot pricing appendix into the contract and add the 80% notification threshold.
jessica: great — assign owners and I'll sync with Legal + AM. Thanks team :raised_hands:
